mapper.insert: insert into TACTIC_CONFIG_OPT (TACTIC_CONFIG_CODE, VDATE, EDATE, OPINION_RINV, REMARK, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) values (#{tacticConfigCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{vdate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{edate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{opinionRinv,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.select: select TACTIC_CONFIG_CODE tacticConfigCode, ASSET_TYPE assetType, THEO_CONFIG_RATE theoConfigRate, SAMLE_AVER_RATE samleAverRate, VIX vix, COR_RATE corRate, COR_SCENE corScene, COR_RATIO corRatio, COR_VIEW corView from TACTIC_CONFIG_OPT_DETAIL where TACTIC_CONFIG_CODE = #{tacticConfigCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select T1.TACTIC_CONFIG_CODE tacticConfigCode, T1.VDATE vdate, T1.EDATE edate, T1.OPINION_RINV opinionRinv, T1.REMARK remark, T2.ASSET_TYPE assetType, T2.THEO_CONFIG_RATE theoConfigRate, T2.SAMLE_AVER_RATE samleAverRate, T2.VIX vix, T2.COR_RATE corRate, T2.COR_SCENE corScene, T2.COR_RATIO corRatio, T2.COR_VIEW corView from TACTIC_CONFIG_OPT T1 left join TACTIC_CONFIG_OPT_DETAIL T2 on T1.TACTIC_CONFIG_CODE = T2.TACTIC_CONFIG_CODE where 1=1
AND T2.COR_SCENE = #{corScene}
and T1.VDATE >= to_date(#{vdate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
and T1.EDATE >= to_date(#{edate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
select TACTIC_CONFIG_CODE tacticConfigCode, VDATE vdate, EDATE edate from (select * from TACTIC_CONFIG_OPT order by VDATE desc) where rownum=1
select TACTIC_CONFIG_CODE tacticConfigCode, VDATE vdate, EDATE edate, OPINION_RINV opinionRinv, REMARK remark from TACTIC_CONFIG_OPT where TACTIC_CONFIG_CODE = #{tacticConfigCode}
